lead_score.description: Composite monetization eligibility score. 0–39 = low/rejected; 40–69 = manual review; 70–100 = approved.

pipeline_status.description: GAB partnership pipeline decision derived from lead_score and hard rejection gates.

projected_ecpm_tier.description: Expected programmatic eCPM band for this domain based on GEO quality, niche, and volume.

rationale.description: Two-sentence analytical justification. Must reference 'programmatic GAB demand ecosystem'. No conversational language.
